title: Research Backplane Output Substrate v1
description: Separates regenerable view/data artifacts from a vendored static renderer. Profiles map to R5 output surfaces: investment_review (Pension-Data workspace bundle), blackline_bundle (Doc-Lineage diff snapshots), mosaic_book (manager-comms mosaic bundles). The run's artifact-manifest/v1 manifest is referenced via manifest_ref; an output_substrate artifact kind may carry this document.

renderer_profile.description: Selects the view-bundle shape and renderer wiring profile per R5 output-substrate brief.

manifest_ref.description: Reference to the run's artifact-manifest/v1 manifest (artifact:manifest.json or a run-dir-relative path).

path.description: Run-dir-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, '..' traversal, backslashes, drive-letter roots, and UNC paths are rejected by the validator.

artifact_id.description: Optional stable ID matching an entry in the referenced artifact manifest.

manifest_csv_exports.description: Manifest-gated CSV exports for Excel refresh workflows. May be empty when no tabular export is published.

source_path.description: JSONPath or consumer-defined pointer into the workspace bundle.

link_profile.description: Evidence-link resolution profile per R5: local-file for synced-folder file:// deep links; artifact-http for loopback or intranet artifact bases.
